declaration.hidden_update_rule: The hidden state is the parity of the current time step (t mod 2), and it toggles every frame.
declaration.mechanism: If t is odd, a cell is alive if none of its orthogonal neighbors were alive in the previous frame. If t is even, a cell is alive if it was alive in the previous frame and had no orthogonal neighbors, or if it was an orthogonal or diagonal neighbor of a cell alive in the previous frame.
